title: The Silver Age (Resource Pack)

# Turn your copper into silver!

**The Silver Age (Resource Pack)** replaces all vanilla copper textures with silver, using original textures from my mod **The Silver Age**. It’s an easy way to get the look of The Silver Age without adding any new content.

 

## The Silver Age

**The Silver Age** is a vanilla-friendly mod that introduces silver, designed to feel like an official game drop you’d expect straight from the developers at Mojang. Get the original mod here:

https://modrinth.com/mod/the-silver-age
